name: graphql_server_errors
description: Requests to /graphql that answered 5xx, from Cloud Run's request logs: what the availability SLO counts as bad.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="my-fake-ecommerce-api" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.requestUrl:"/graphql" AND httpRequest.status>=500
